verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. In both, the headline breaks one word per line ('Make / the / longest / day / last') and takes up most of the skyscraper, which swamps everything else. The CTA, the '25% off' line and the legal text are crammed into the bottom fifth: the legal copy is jammed under the button and against the bottom edge, and the decorative circles are gone. A's sun icon and SOLSTICE wordmark are slightly larger and easier to read, while B's logo has shrunk to an almost illegible speck above the ribbon. That makes A marginally less bad on brand.
